title: Hearty Molten Dutch Semolina Pasta
description: A rich and creamy Dutch dish featuring semolina pasta, tempered chocolate, and a blend of fatty ingredients, all while being FODMAP friendly. This recipe is perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the semolina pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a medium saucepan, melt the unsalted butter over low heat.
Add the tempering chocolate to the melted butter and stir until smooth and well combined.
In a large skillet, combine the heavy cream, grana padano cheese, and a pinch of salt and pepper, and stir over low heat until the cheese is melted and the sauce is smooth.
In a small bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Temper the eggs by slowly pouring the warm cheese sauce into the eggs, whisking constantly.
Add the cooked semolina pasta to the cheese sauce and stir until well coated.
Add the tempered chocolate and butter mixture to the pasta and stir until well combined.
Season the pasta with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the pasta hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
